props.title: Chelsey Webb joins Signet Artists
props.seo_title: Chelsey Webb, Denver country singer, joins Signet Artists
props.dek: Country singer Chelsey Webb, the Colorado Country Music Hall of Fame’s 2025 Female Entertainer of the Year, is now one of our Featured Artists.
props.meta_description: Denver country singer Chelsey Webb, 2025 Female Entertainer of the Year, joins Signet Artists. Book her as a duo or with her five or six-piece band.
props.llms_description: This post announces that Chelsey Webb, a Denver country singer raised in Alabama and named Female Entertainer of the Year at the 2025 Colorado Country Music Hall of Fame awards, is now a Featured Artist with Signet Artists. It covers the stages she has played, the covers and original songs she performs, and how to book her as a duo or with her five or six-piece band for weddings, parties and corporate events in Colorado.

hero.alt: Chelsey Webb in a white top and a turquoise thunderbird necklace, sitting forward on a blue cushion in a dim retro lounge.

video.title: Chelsey Webb and her band playing a dance medley into Here for the Party

props.html:
We have some exciting news if you’ve been hoping to book a country band in Denver. Chelsey Webb is now one of our Featured Artists, and we’re thrilled to have her on our Artist Roster!

Chelsey grew up in Alabama, recorded in Nashville and now makes her home in Denver. She has a big, smoky voice, a lot of Southern gospel in her background and, in her own words, a little bit of outlaw.

props.caption: Chelsey and her band playing a dance medley of Shut Up and Dance, I Wanna Dance with Somebody and Girls Just Want to Have Fun, into Here for the Party.

props.html:
In 2025 the Colorado Country Music Hall of Fame named Chelsey its Female Entertainer of the Year, and The Denver Gazette was there for it.

You may have seen her at Cheyenne Frontier Days, the Greeley Stampede or the National Western Stock Show. She’s also shared the stage with country artists like Tracy Byrd, Jackson Dean and Corey Kent.

props.text: Booking Chelsey Webb for your event

props.html:
You can book Chelsey as a duo with her husband on acoustic guitar, which is a warm fit for a cocktail hour, a dinner or a party at home.

When you want people dancing, bring in her full band. It has fiddle, acoustic and electric guitar and drums, and the six-piece adds pedal steel for that classic country sound.

Her song list goes from Sweet Home Alabama, Neon Moon and Here for the Party to Party in the U.S.A. and Espresso, and she plays her own songs too. Want to see more? Check out Chelsey’s video clips and song list.

props.headline: Want to book Chelsey for your event?
props.html: Just send us your date and venue, and we’ll let you know if she’s available.
